long_biography.plain_text:
The son of fruit growers in the Noordoostpolder, Willem Blijdorp studied at Maastricht's hotel school before joining the excursion operator Kamstra with his classmate Jacques Streng. They advertised its duty-free shopping trips in local newspapers, increased passenger demand and eventually bought the business. Streng concentrated on tourism while Blijdorp handled buying and selling, sourcing discounted batches that manufacturers wanted to clear.

Blijdorp pledged €10 million to Papageno after its founder Aaltje van Zweden-van Buuren described her ambition to establish a house in every Dutch province. His donation was intended to help expand homes where young adults with autism could live and work with assistance.
long_biography.html:
The son of fruit growers in the Noordoostpolder, Willem Blijdorp studied at Maastricht's hotel school before joining the excursion operator Kamstra with his classmate Jacques Streng. They advertised its duty-free shopping trips in local newspapers, increased passenger demand and eventually bought the business. Streng concentrated on tourism while Blijdorp handled buying and selling, sourcing discounted batches that manufacturers wanted to clear.

Blijdorp pledged €10 million to Papageno after its founder Aaltje van Zweden-van Buuren described her ambition to establish a house in every Dutch province. His donation was intended to help expand homes where young adults with autism could live and work with assistance.
